leads.title: Goa Civil Code - marriage provision
leads.documents: Defines marriage as between a man and a woman; no recognition for same-sex marriages or civil unions in Goa
leads.detail: Cited as 'Goa applies the Goa Civil Code, which defines marriage as between a man and a woman'; no URL visible

leads.title: Supreme Court of India 2023 same-sex marriage decision
leads.documents: Declined to legalise same-sex marriage but noted same-sex couples have right to cohabit and some protections
leads.detail: Cited as 'Supreme Court's decision not to legalise same-sex marriage' and 'in 2023, the Supreme Court noted that same-sex couples have the right to cohabit'; no case name or URL visible

leads.title: Goa Public Health Act - Dominic D'Souza case (1989)
leads.documents: Forcible quarantine after HIV-positive test; first documented HIV rights activism case in Goa used in queer activism
leads.detail: Cited as 'In 1989, Dominic D'Souza was forcibly quarantined under Goa's Public Health Act after testing HIV-positive'; no URL visible

leads.title: Minister Ramesh Tawadkar proposal Jan 2015 / CM Laxmikant Parsekar response
leads.documents: Documented state-level incident: proposal for treatment centres to 'cure' LGBT youth and CM distancing, calling homosexuality a 'natural quality'
leads.detail: Cited as 'Sports and Youth Affairs Minister Ramesh Tawadkar proposed setting up treatment centres' and Chief Minister Laxmikant Parsekar clarification; no URL visible

leads.title: Census of India 2011 / Goa electoral rolls 2022-2024
leads.documents: Official count of 398 transgender people in Goa in 2011; only 12 transgender people registered in electoral rolls as of 2024, first registered in 2022
leads.detail: Cited as 'According to the 2011 census' and electoral roll figures; no URL visible

leads.title: Goa Livelihoods Forum study (2018)
leads.documents: Human-rights report: 63% of LGBTQ individuals reported workplace verbal abuse, 87% of transgender respondents dropped out of school due to harassment
leads.detail: Cited as 'According to a 2018 study by the Goa Livelihoods Forum'; no URL visible
